card.name: Start of a dose number in combo products
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a strength number (such as 200, 400, 5 mL, 8 hours) in dosing tables, mostly for combination products like amoxicillin/clavulanate and lopinavir/ritonavir.

modes.label: Space before strength
modes.description: The space after words like per, Dosage or daily, right before a dose figure.
modes.example: 400 mg/57 mg per<< >>5 mL suspensions of Amoxicillin

modes.label: First digit of strength
modes.description: The first digit of a dose number in a combination product.
modes.example: Lopinavir and Ritonavir Dosage Form Recommended Dosage <<2>>00 mg/50 mg Tablets

card.writes: The promoted words are about contracts, which has no link to dosing, so there is no sensible output effect.
card.plain: It lights up just before a dose number appears in a table of combination drug strengths.
